name: sol8-source-controls
goal: Show open selection options, empty-file status and linked filenames in every responsive catalog capture

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Select options must be painted in-page; empty files must show an explicit status; linked filenames must be visibly underlined; lightbox shots frame their real content.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing tests accepted native open state without painted options, empty code, and control counts without link paint. Existing catalog assertions now check those pixels and semantics after capture.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Red 8ee814b5 at dac1ace686 retains 96 responsive captures and fails the painted-listbox, empty-file status and linked-filename guards.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 3701740174 renders visible Select options, explicit empty-file status and underlined filenames without changing the frozen tests.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: 36886229 passes the unchanged 96-case matrix at 3701740174 against red b880db3e, using the same fixed runtime environment.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
